answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A anchor of per-task receipts records who did what, and the raven of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the spiral of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
